info.title: Sofa King server
info.description: The Sofa King media center server's HTTP interface: the API the Sofa King app uses under /api/v1 for live TV, recordings and media libraries, the admin API under /api/v1/admin, the player outputs under /output, the logo cache and the HDHomeRun emulation Plex reads. The admin portal under /admin is HTML and is not described here. Timestamps are UTC instants.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Public checks that take no token.

tags.name: Live TV
tags.description: The catalog and guide the app reads. Bearer: the API token.

tags.name: Playback
tags.description: Sessions that select a source and relay its media. Bearer: the API token; the media URLs take none.

tags.name: Sources
tags.description: Provider and source health. Bearer: the API token.

tags.name: Outputs
tags.description: The M3U playlist, XMLTV guide and player streams. Token: the output token as ?token= or a bearer, or the API bearer.

tags.name: HDHomeRun
tags.description: What Plex reads from an HDHomeRun tuner. No token; clients are admitted by address (SOFA_HDHR_ALLOW and the addresses allowed at run time).

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: The server, its sessions, candidates, guides and the lineup. Bearer: the admin token, or the API token when none is set.

tags.name: Policy
tags.description: The lineup policy and its runs. Bearer: the admin token.

tags.name: Plex
tags.description: Plex Live TV sync. Bearer: the admin token.

tags.name: Viewers
tags.description: Pairing a client to the server and the preferences each client keeps on it. Bearer: the API token, except the pairing claim, which takes none.

tags.name: Library
tags.description: Media libraries: folders of movies, shows and other videos under SOFA_MEDIA_DIR, which the server reads and never writes. The app's routes take the API token; /artwork takes none; the admin routes take the admin token.

tags.name: Recordings
tags.description: The DVR: recordings and the series rules that schedule them. Bearer: the API token.

subtitleIndex.description: A picture subtitle track from the item's subtitles to draw into the picture, which converts the stream. A text track or a recording answers 400.

wholePlaylist.description: For a player that cannot restart a conversion: a transcode serves a VOD playlist of the whole item, with startMs 0, and converts from the segment the player asks for.

Where in the item the HLS stream's time 0 is; 0 for direct play.

recordingId.description: Set, with an empty itemId, when the session plays a recording.

hidden.description: Channel ids the client leaves out.

favorites.description: Starred channel ids, in the viewer's order.

updatedAt.description: Set by the server on every write.

preferences.description: Null until the client saves some.

offerings.description: The entry's sources in failover order

status.description: A health status, or WITHDRAWN when no provider lists the source now

CreateLineupEntry.description: With channelId, the candidate's number, name, logo, group, sources and guide mapping are copied and any field here overrides them; without it, number and name are required.

UpdateLineupEntry.description: Absent fields keep their value; the clear flags remove optional values. Sending enabled clears autoDisabledAt and autoDisabledReason.

policyPath.description: The starter policy file, when the write built one with starterPolicy=true

HdhrAccessStatus.description: Who may reach the HDHomeRun emulation. open is true when every address is admitted (a loopback bind with no address configured or allowed).

allowed.description: Allowed from the portal or this API, kept in the database

refused.description: Up to 10 addresses refused since the start that are still refused, newest first

items.description: An IP literal or CIDR block

SaveTmdbToken.description: A TMDB API read access token or v3 API key.

items.description: Present items by kind: movie, show, season, episode or video.

scanOk.description: False when the last scan found the folder missing, or empty while the library held files.

unavailable.description: The folder was missing or empty, so nothing changed.

startsAt.description: The program's start; recording begins startPaddingSeconds earlier.

endsAt.description: The program's end; recording runs endPaddingSeconds later.

reason.description: Why a recording failed or was cut short: MISSED, NO_MEDIA, STOPPED, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED and the like.

conflict.description: A scheduled recording that overlaps more recordings than the server has playback slots.

commercials.description: How far the commercial scan of a kept recording got; null when the server does not look.

startMs.description: From the start of the file.

usedBytes.description: What running and kept recordings use.

keep.description: Finished recordings the rule keeps, newest first; 0 keeps all.

post.summary: Claim a pairing code for the API token
post.description: The code comes from the admin portal's Viewers page or POST /api/v1/admin/pairing-codes; it is live for ten minutes and works once, and five wrong claims void it. No bearer token: 10 claims a minute per client address, then 429. A server without an API token answers an empty one.

429.description: Too many claims from this address

get.summary: The preferences this client last saved

put.description: Each list holds at most 1,000 distinct ids; an empty name or platform keeps the stored one. The answer is the stored document with the server's updatedAt.

get.summary: The catalog: the enabled lineup entries as channels
get.description: Carries an ETag; If-None-Match answers 304.

post.summary: Programmes overlapping a window for up to 200 channels

get.summary: Each provider's import status and counts
Every source's health and manual-disable flag

patch.summary: Disable or enable a source by hand
patch.description: A disabled source is never selected or probed; sessions playing it move on.

post.summary: Open a preview or watch session
post.description: Picks the channel's first selectable source. Repeating a key returns the same session while it lives; a key reused with other parameters answers 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. At capacity the oldest preview, then an idle player session, yields; otherwise 429 CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED.

get.description: Moves the session to the next selectable source, with a new epoch, when the current one stopped being selectable.

patch.summary: Renew the lease; optionally change the intent
patch.description: A watch session expires 90 s after its last renewal, a preview 45 s. Send {} to renew alone.

get.summary: A playlist, segment, key or live TS stream of the session
get.description: No token: the random resource token authorizes it until the session ends or its epoch changes. An older epoch answers 410 STREAM_CHANGED; a source no longer selectable answers 503 SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; more than 12 requests at once answer 429.

200.description: application/vnd.apple.mpegurl, video/mp2t or the resource's own type

get.summary: The enabled lineup as an M3U playlist
get.description: audio/x-mpegurl; tvg-id is the channel id, URLs use the request's Host. The stream suffix follows the protocol of the source the channel would play now.
From three hours ago to days ahead; the server's runtime setting applies when days is absent.

get.summary: Open a player session for the channel and stream it
get.description: An HLS source answers 302 to the session's playlist; an MPEG-TS source streams video/mp2t here. The session is released 60 s after the last media request.
key is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the logo's source URL. Carries an ETag and Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400.

200.description: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG

get.summary: One page of a library's movies, shows or videos
Continue watching, Recently added per library, and the libraries
Titles holding q: movies, shows and videos, then episodes
get.description: Movies, shows and videos whose title holds q, then those with a cast member or director whose name holds it, then episodes by title. At most 50.

get.summary: An item with its seasons or episodes, a show's next episode and a file's tracks

put.summary: Record where playback stopped, or mark an item watched
put.description: A stop in the first 5% leaves the item where it was; one at 90% or later marks it watched. A show or season takes watched only, and marks every episode in it.

get.summary: A text subtitle track of the item as WebVTT
get.description: index is a subtitle track's index from the item: a stream of its file, or from 1000 a subtitle file beside it. Times are in the item's time. The first read extracts the stream, which reads the whole file; later reads serve the kept copy. A picture subtitle answers 415 SUBTITLE_NOT_TEXT.

post.summary: Play a library movie, episode or video
post.description: Direct play when the profile takes the file as is; otherwise HLS that FFmpeg remuxes or converts. At most SOFA_MAX_TRANSCODES convert at once.

patch.summary: Renew the session, or restart its converted stream
patch.description: A session lasts five minutes past its last renewal or media request.

get.summary: The lineup policy the server runs with
get.description: 404 POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED without one. The revision is also the ETag.

put.summary: Replace the policy and apply it
put.description: The body is the whole policy, up to 4 MiB. If-Match is required: 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED without it, 409 POLICY_CHANGED when stale, 400 INVALID_POLICY with every error.

get.summary: What a run would change; writes nothing

post.description: Writes the lineup when it differs, logs each change and writes assigned numbers and learned aliases back to the file.

post.summary: Write the starter policy and restart
post.description: The configured providers in the server's priority order (an HDHomeRun tuner first), the shipped group map and number blocks and health.requireVerified, written to SOFA_POLICY or policy.json in the data directory; the server then restarts to run it. 409 POLICY_EXISTS when a policy is configured or the file exists, 409 NO_SOURCES with no providers.

get.summary: Open findings of a run over the current candidates

get.description: The server keeps the newest 10,000.

get.summary: Why a station key is what it is

get.description: Providers and guides as the file holds them, ${NAME} references unexpanded; an empty document when the server has no source file.

put.summary: Replace the source file and restart
put.description: Validates the document the way the start does (400 INVALID_SOURCES with the reason, nothing written), writes it atomically where the server reads it (SOFA_SOURCES, else sources.json in the data directory) and ends the process once the response is sent; the container's restart policy starts it again. With starterPolicy=true it also writes the starter lineup policy for the document's providers before that one restart (409 POLICY_EXISTS when a policy is configured, 409 NO_SOURCES without providers).

parameters.name: starterPolicy
parameters.description: true also writes the starter policy

put.summary: Save the TMDB token and restart
put.description: Asks TMDB whether it takes the token, stores it as tmdbToken in secrets.json in the data directory and ends the process once the response is sent. 400 INVALID_REQUEST for a value that cannot be a token, 400 TMDB_REJECTED when TMDB refuses it, 502 TMDB_UNREACHABLE when TMDB cannot be asked, 409 TMDB_FROM_ENVIRONMENT when SOFA_TMDB_TOKEN sets it, 500 SECRETS_UNWRITABLE when secrets.json cannot be read or written; nothing is written then. SOFA_TMDB_TOKEN wins over the saved token.

get.description: 404 PLEX_NOT_CONFIGURED when SOFA_PLEX_URL is unset.

post.description: A failure is reported in lastError, not as an error response.

get.description: The addresses from SOFA_HDHR_ALLOW, the ones allowed at run time, and the addresses refused lately.

put.summary: Replace the addresses allowed at run time
put.description: Applies at once with no restart and is kept in the database. SOFA_HDHR_ALLOW still applies beside it. 400 INVALID_REQUEST names an entry that is not an IP literal or CIDR block; nothing changes then.

get.summary: Every client that paired or saved preferences
get.description: Most recently seen first.

delete.summary: Forget a client and its preferences
delete.description: The client keeps working and reappears on its next save.

post.description: Replaces the live code. The code is six digits, live for ten minutes, and spent by the claim that matches it.

get.description: With each library's present items by kind and its last scan.

post.description: The folder must be inside SOFA_MEDIA_DIR, lead nowhere outside it and be used by no other library (409 LIBRARY_EXISTS); its first scan starts at once.

get.summary: The folders a new library can use
get.description: SOFA_MEDIA_DIR and its subfolders two levels down, without hidden folders and those a library already uses.

delete.description: Forgets its items and their watch progress; the files are never touched.

post.description: Answers when the scan ends. A folder that is missing, or empty while the library held files, reads as unmounted: unavailable is true and nothing changes.

get.summary: Every recording, scheduled and running soonest first, then kept and failed newest first

post.description: Names the program by its channel and start, as the guide query gives them. Scheduling a program that already has a recording answers that recording.

patch.summary: Protect a recording from culling, or save where the viewer stopped

delete.summary: Cancel, stop or delete a recording
delete.description: Cancels a scheduled recording, stops a running one and keeps what it recorded, or deletes a finished one and its file. A cancelled airing of a rule is not scheduled again.

delete.summary: Delete a series rule and its scheduled recordings; what it recorded stays
